_doc: Rubrics are DATA; the judge is domain-agnostic. To add a new domain, write a rubric — you don't touch the engine. Each criterion carries a `guide` (what good looks like) and a `weight`; optional `anchors` calibrate the scale (a 9 vs a 3); optional `examples` are calibration samples with known scores. Ported from atelier-engine/lib/rubrics.js — same eight rubrics, ready for new ones via PR.

criteria.name: Colourway coherence
criteria.guide: The per-zone colours read as one intentional colourway, not random.

criteria.name: One iconic feature
criteria.guide: A single strong signature detail leads; the rest stays restrained (not a committee shoe).

criteria.name: Material honesty
criteria.guide: Materials are real and plausible for the silhouette; no fantasy/greenwashed materials.

criteria.name: Buildable spec
criteria.guide: The spec is specific enough that a sample room could make it (zones, materials, construction named).

criteria.name: Story / point of view
criteria.guide: There's a clear reason this design exists; it's not generic.

anchors.high: Forest-green suede court low with one tan-suede flight panel, gum sole, full zone spec + a clear training-run story.
anchors.low: A vibrant futuristic eco sneaker, cool vibes.

criteria.name: Dial legibility & proportion
criteria.guide: Indices, hands and any sub-dials are balanced, symmetric and readable; case/lug proportions are correct.

criteria.name: Complication coherence
criteria.guide: Complications (date, chrono sub-dials, bezel) fit the silhouette and don't crowd or contradict each other.

criteria.name: Movement-material honesty
criteria.guide: Movement and materials are plausible together (no quartz-styled tourbillon, no dive bezel on a dress slim).

criteria.name: Buildable spec
criteria.guide: Case, movement, crystal, strap and per-part finishes are specific enough for a watchmaker to quote.

criteria.name: Story / point of view
criteria.guide: A clear reason this watch exists; not a generic homage.

anchors.high: 38mm steel field watch, automatic, domed sapphire, cream dial with blued hands, tan strap — full part spec + a clear daily-wear story.
anchors.low: A cool luxury smartwatch-looking thing with lots of dials.

criteria.name: Cut & fit honesty
criteria.guide: Cut, collar and fit match the sport and silhouette (match-fit vs retro vs aero).

criteria.name: Panel / colour-block coherence
criteria.guide: Body, sleeves, side panels and trim read as one intentional kit, not random blocking.

criteria.name: Fabric honesty
criteria.guide: Fabric weight and finish suit the sport (aero mesh for racing, heavy cotton for retro).

criteria.name: Buildable spec
criteria.guide: Cut, fabric, panels and per-panel colours are specific enough for a kit manufacturer to produce.

criteria.name: Brand-neutral & clean
criteria.guide: No real club crest, league patch or sponsor text; any number/name is intentional, not accidental clutter.

anchors.high: Athletic-fit football jersey, forest-green body, cream rib V-collar, tan side panels, recycled poly — full panel spec, clean and brand-neutral.
anchors.low: A generic team shirt with a random logo and 'SPONSOR' across the chest.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.guide: Each sentence is unambiguous; a smart non-expert follows it on first read.

criteria.name: Concreteness
criteria.guide: Claims are specific and grounded, not abstract hand-waving.

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.guide: Ideas are ordered so each builds on the last.

criteria.name: No fluff
criteria.guide: No filler, hedging, or marketing padding; every sentence earns its place.

anchors.high: Tight, concrete, ordered; cuts straight to the point with examples.
anchors.low: Long, abstract, full of 'leverage synergies to unlock value'.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.guide: Does what it claims; no logic bugs; edge cases handled.

criteria.name: Robustness
criteria.guide: Validates inputs, handles errors/nulls, no obvious crash paths.

criteria.name: Security
criteria.guide: No injection, no secrets, no unsafe eval/exec, safe data handling.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.guide: Clear names, small scope, readable without comments.

anchors.high: Validated inputs, parameterised queries, handled edge cases, clear names.
anchors.low: String-concatenated SQL, no validation, one-letter names, silent failures.

examples.artifact: function add(a,b){ if(typeof a!=='number'||typeof b!=='number') throw new Error('nums'); return a+b; }
function q(d,x){ return d.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id="+x); }

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.guide: Unambiguous; a non-lawyer grasps the obligation and who it binds.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.guide: Covers scope, exceptions, duration, remedy — no dangling gaps.

criteria.name: Balance / fairness
criteria.guide: Not unconscionably one-sided; obligations are mutual where expected.

criteria.name: Enforceability
criteria.guide: Specific and definite enough to be enforced; no vague 'reasonable efforts' alone.

anchors.high: Defines the obligation, scope, carve-outs, duration and remedy in plain, mutual terms.
anchors.low: 'Party may do things as appropriate' — vague, one-sided, no scope or remedy.

criteria.name: Relevance / personalization
criteria.guide: Clearly written for THIS recipient, not a blast; a specific reason to care.

criteria.name: Brevity
criteria.guide: Short enough to read in 15 seconds; no padding.

criteria.name: Specific value
criteria.guide: A concrete, credible benefit — not 'synergies' or 'solutions'.

criteria.name: Clear ask
criteria.guide: One easy, specific next step.

anchors.high: Two lines, names a real trigger, one concrete benefit, a yes/no ask.
anchors.low: Six paragraphs about the sender, buzzwords, 'let's hop on a call to explore synergies'.

criteria.name: Quantified impact
criteria.guide: A measurable result with numbers (%, time, money, scale).

criteria.name: Action & ownership
criteria.guide: Strong verb; clear what THIS person did, not the team.

criteria.name: Specificity
criteria.guide: Concrete what/how (tools, method), not vague 'various tasks'.

criteria.name: Concise
criteria.guide: One tight line; no filler.

anchors.high: Cut API p95 latency 40% (820 -> 490ms) by adding Redis caching, serving 2M req/day.
anchors.low: Responsible for helping with various backend tasks and supporting the team.
